mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO question_favorite (user_id, question_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_favorite f JOIN question q ON q.id = f.question_id

SELECT f.question_id, q.title, q.difficulty, q.category_id, c.name AS category_name, q.view_count, f.create_time AS favorite_time FROM question_favorite f JOIN question q ON q.id = f.question_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{query.pageSize}
